solver_contract.dependencies: Python standard library only; pyproject has no numeric dependency; no additional dependency/scope
solver_contract.column_scaling: Divide each feature by its positive maximum over training samples; zero feature column coefficient fixed0. Re-express fitted weights in original token units.
solver_contract.coordinate_update: Fixed-order exact nonnegative single-coordinate least-squares minimizer holding others fixed; zero intercept
solver_contract.termination: Both max coefficient change and objective change <=1e-12 relative tolerance, deterministic max100000 sweeps; nonconvergence/nonfinite/poorly-identified required prediction -> fail closed
solver_contract.ties: Zero initialization and fixed feature order define deterministic fitted representative; record rank/coverage in uncertainty review; never claim unique identifiable weights from3samples alone
solver_contract.serialization: Stable feature ordering and plain-data dump, deterministic numeric rounding convention documented and tested, no negative coefficients
